parameters.content:
## Lead follow-up: score, reply, CRM, alert
Every new website-form lead gets an instant reply, is scored 1–10 by OpenAI, upserted into HubSpot, and — if it's hot — pushed to Slack.

**What you need:** n8n • OpenAI API key • HubSpot private-app token • SMTP • Slack incoming webhook

**Setup**
1. Open **Config** → set business name, from-address, booking link, Slack URL, hot-lead score.
2. Header-Auth credential `OpenAI` (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`) on **Score lead**.
3. Header-Auth credential `HubSpot` (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) on **Upsert contact**.
4. Add your SMTP credential to **Reply to lead**.
5. Point your form's webhook at **New lead**'s production URL, activate, send a test.

No credentials are bundled — every `REPLACE_ME` must be set before activating.
Guide: pushbuild.com/guides/lead-follow-up-automation.html

### 1 · Receive & normalize
Webhook takes the form POST; **Config** holds your settings; **Normalize lead** maps form fields to name/email/phone/company/message.

### 2 · Score with OpenAI
Asks OpenAI for a 1–10 fit score, a reason and a one-line summary.

### 3 · Reply, CRM & alert
Sends the thank-you email, upserts the HubSpot contact, and Slacks the sales team when the score clears your threshold.
